---
name: Removal request
about: You made a talk, ran an event, or own a channel indexed here and want it out.
title: "Removal request: <channel / video id / span>"
labels: takedown
---

You do not have to prove anything or explain why. Name what should go:

- **Channel**: <!-- channel name or URL, for everything indexed from it -->
- **Video**: <!-- youtu.be URL or 11-character id -->
- **Span inside a video**: <!-- timestamps, if it's one segment — see docs/takedown.md §5 for what's possible -->

Who you are in relation to it (speaker / organiser / channel owner — one line
is enough):

<!-- your line here -->

The promise this repo makes: acknowledged and actioned within **72 hours**
(usually much faster). The full procedure, including what gets deleted and
what a CDN may briefly keep serving, is public in
[docs/takedown.md](../../docs/takedown.md). If you'd rather not post details
publicly, say only "removal request — details privately" and the operator
will follow up.
